text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... pant...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
...Not bad at all. At least I had a good
showing.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huh?! What's all this cheering?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Hey, everyone! Thanks for the support!
Hehehe, I
was pretty cool, wasn't I?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
But I'm not done yet! Don't take your
eyes off me
for a second!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
I promise here and now that I will
continue to
exceed everyone's
expectations!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Токай Тэйо signing out! See ya! ♪
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The crowd was going wild. I guess that's
Teio for
you.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
...It was stupid of me to challenge
someone like
that.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
And guess what? I'm right back here

again—reaching out for something that
doesn't
belong to me.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: I feel so dumb.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: She's so bright...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Um... I'm back...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Haha. You don't have to say that.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I mean, hey, I did fulfill your request,
didn't I?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
You told me to do what I always do.
Well, mission
complete.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
The "challenging myself" part was
unnecessary.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Nothing ever changes, regardless of
what my
mindset is.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: ...And that goes for my feelings too.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Aaargh! My shiny dream is totally out of
my
reach!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Her results this time are quite good.
Even if she
didn't finish first, she should
still hold her head
high.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But instead, she's feeling down. Perhaps
an
overall lack of confidence is a factor.
In that case,
what she needs is...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Nature, do you wanna go on a little trip?

text_block_list.text: A trip? But why now?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: Let's go get a win this summer.

text_block_list.text:
It's a risky gamble to ask her to compete
in the
Classics right now. She could lose
what little
confidence she has.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Winning at local races and steadily
accumulating
wins will be better for her
overall growth.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Are you saying... I'm not going to be
competing in
Satsuki Sho or Japanese
Derby?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Because I'm not good enough?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list:
Right now, we should focus on building up your
skills.

text_block_list.text: Okay.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
You're right. The way I am now, I
couldn't win a
big race even if I entered.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: After this summer, you'll be even faster.

text_block_list.text: I hope that's the case.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Phew...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Okay, then! Touring in a caravan is more
my style,
anyway.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But we're not actually doing that, are
we?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: What kind of race are you thinking of?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
A graded race that takes place in
Kokura... the
perfect race for Nice
Nature to gain some
confidence.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Huh, that one is the same distance as
Wakagoma,
right? I think that's a good
idea.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But summer in Kokura... Yay... I love
sweating...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
And so, we decide to aim for the Kokura
Kinen
next!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
